items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Stitt wasn't tryin' to imitate him just like I wasn't tryin' to imitate Christian... Sonny was playin', but Parker beat him to it.

ctx.x: How would you compare his playing to Art Tatum?

... different style... He made a lot of runs... Style is what counts... Parker was just about untouchable except for... Sonny Stitt. Just like I said, Sonny Stitt wasn't tryin' to imitate him just like I wasn't tryin' to imitate Christian. It just came out that way... Sonny was playin', but Parker beat him to it. But man, Sonny... you can't imitate that kind of stuff overnight. He just happened to be in the same category. So...
